context:
Both already passed on your Mac on Oct 27. Each step (c29 and c58) can only close when Windows passes too.

The decision watch (c29) is a small program that reads each turn and records whether it followed your recorded decisions; "judged" means it ran and gave a verdict, "UNKNOWN" means it could not run. The mods (c58) are the small add-ons claude-settings installs into the Claude app; each should update itself to the version on main.
ref: c29 (decision watch runs again), c58 (mods update themselves)
steps: Restart the Claude app on your Windows PC and take one turn (any message).

Open the file %USERPROFILE%\.claude\decision-watch-shadow\shadow.log and read its last lines. The newest END line should name a verdict (such as ALLOW or FLAG); if it says UNKNOWN, the decision watch could not judge the turn.
In a terminal, run: claude plugin list. Each claude-settings mod should show the version on main (the decision watch shows 0.0.11 or later).
Mark done. If either check failed, add a note saying which and what it showed.
title: Two checks on your Windows PC: the decision watch and the mod updates
